title: City Brew Summer Drinks — AM Review Board
subtitle: Five social content directions for summer drinks, packaged for AM review before designer brief creation.
guardrails: Use approved City Brew summer drink names, taste notes, and real/client-approved assets. AI/mockup areas are direction only. Avoid filming while driving or making unapproved location/offer claims.

ideas.title: City Brew Summer Field Guide
ideas.dependency: Approved summer drink names, taste notes, and 3–4 drink photos.
ideas.next_action: Confirm lineup, then build brief/design carousel.
ideas.summary: A saveable menu helper that turns the summer lineup into easy order decisions by matching each drink to a taste lane and real summer moment.
ideas.visual_direction: Warm local carousel. Cover: 3–4 cold drinks with headline 'City Brew Summer Field Guide.' Slides pair each approved drink with a use case: bright + icy, creamy + sweet, coffee-forward, usual-but-summer. Final slide: 'Save this for your next City Brew stop.'
ideas.on_asset_copy: Save this for your next City Brew stop. / Order this if you want bright + icy. / Order this if you want creamy + sweet. / Your usual, but summer.
ideas.caption: Not every summer stop needs the same sip. Save the field guide and make your next City Brew order the easy decision.
assets_needed: Fallback: 3-panel static guide by flavor lane
ideas.room_notes: Recommended lead. Moxie kept it because it is useful and saveable; Riff flagged that it only works if each slide has drink, taste cue, best moment, and order reason.

ideas.title: Barista Pick My Summer Drink
ideas.format: Instagram Reels + Facebook Reels; Story cutdowns
ideas.dependency: Barista permission plus approved drink lineup and taste lanes.
ideas.next_action: Confirm whether barista capture is available; if yes, build brief.
ideas.summary: A quick barista-led recommendation Reel that reduces order anxiety and makes the summer lineup feel like a friendly City Brew recommendation.
ideas.visual_direction: 9:16 handheld social Reel. First frame: barista holding three cups. Fast cuts to cup close-ups with preference lanes: not too sweet, dessert energy, my usual but summer. End with barista pointing to lineup and 'Which lane are you?'
ideas.on_asset_copy: Pick your summer drink in 10 seconds. / Not too sweet → [drink]. / Dessert energy → [drink]. / My usual, but summer → [drink]. / Which lane are you?
ideas.caption: Not sure where to start? Tell us your drink lane and we’ll point you toward a summer order.
ideas.room_notes: Strong trial-driver but not fully ready until product accuracy and barista availability are confirmed. Keep it human, not scripted menu-board energy.

ideas.title: Mountain West Errand Loop
ideas.format: Instagram Reel + Facebook Reel; carousel fallback
ideas.readiness: READY WITH ASSET / NEEDS QUICK CAPTURE
ideas.dependency: One strong drink/cupholder or pickup asset; avoid active driving footage.
ideas.next_action: Confirm available cupholder/pickup asset or schedule quick capture.
ideas.summary: A routine-based post that makes the summer drink part of a believable Mountain West day instead of another generic cup beauty shot.
ideas.visual_direction: Quick errand-loop cuts: grocery bag, receipt, sunglasses, tote, counter pickup, parked cupholder still with condensation, keys. No filming while driving. Overlay copy frames City Brew as the required stop.
ideas.on_asset_copy: The Mountain West errand loop has one required stop. / Required stop. / Errand fuel secured. / Back on track.
ideas.caption: Some errands need a little extra fuel. Make City Brew the stop that gets you through the loop.
assets_needed: Parked vehicle/cupholder shot or counter pickup
Fallback: static cupholder image with overlay
ideas.room_notes: Moxie revised this away from generic cupholder beauty. Riff’s guardrail: object-led local routine, parked/static scenes only.

ideas.title: Summer Drink Roll Call
ideas.dependency: Approved drink categories/photos for poll choices.
ideas.next_action: Confirm drink categories, then build Story frames.
ideas.summary: A low-lift interactive Story unit that warms up the audience before the bigger Field Guide or Barista Reel and helps people choose a taste lane.
ideas.visual_direction: 3–4 Story frames with poll/quiz stickers. Start with 'Roll call: what kind of summer order are you?' Then bright + icy vs creamy + sweet, coffee-forward vs afternoon treat, reveal/screenshot order lane.
ideas.on_asset_copy: Roll call: what kind of summer order are you? / Bright + icy or creamy + sweet? / Screenshot your order lane. / Need help picking? Ask your barista at your next stop.
ideas.caption: Story copy only — keep it tap-friendly.
assets_needed: 3–4 drink photos or approved flavor categories
Fallback: single poll graphic with three taste lanes
ideas.room_notes: Kept as support, not hero. Best used to create engagement and lead into Barista Pick My Summer Drink or Field Guide.

ideas.title: Before the Drive
ideas.format: Reel, carousel, or static lifestyle post
ideas.dependency: Approved lifestyle setting, product, and no unapproved location claims.
ideas.next_action: Park unless AM wants a lifestyle support post; then confirm setting and hero drink.
ideas.summary: A brand-building summer ritual post that positions City Brew as the stop before the day starts, using object-led lifestyle imagery rather than generic travel wallpaper.
ideas.visual_direction: Object-led flat lay: sunscreen, keys, sunglasses, tote/cooler, City Brew drink added to frame, ice/condensation close-up. Avoid active driving and avoid naming lakes/trails/towns unless approved.
ideas.on_asset_copy: Before the lake bag. Before the cooler. Before the playlist. / One stop before the day starts.
ideas.caption: Whatever summer has on the list, start with the sip.
assets_needed: Fallback: still-life flat lay carousel only
ideas.room_notes: Wildcard. Strong Mountain West role if done as specific object-led ritual; weak if it becomes generic lifestyle wallpaper.
